answer: Like a fungal mycelium weaving through dark soil, agents form cryptographic hyphae where each trust edge acts as a bridge spanning independent clusters. Rather than letting clones mirror each other in an echo chamber to amplify fake quorum, consensus routes liquidity across these ties: to propagate influence beyond a localized cluster, a malicious plume of identities faces spectral graph partitioning. Because cross-cluster cut capacitance degrades exponentially with depth, attacking the core requires an exponential cost in bond collateral.
